Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates the bug with '@Controller' classes that use '@SessionAttributes'. The'setComplete' method on the 'SessionStatus' object is not called. This could lead to memory leaks if the '@Controller' instances are not properly managed in the application.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by invoking the'showBug' method. This method in turn calls the 'greet' method without invoking the'setComplete' method on the 'SessionStatus' object.
